### How does the ATS Resume Checker work?

Our ATS checker analyzes your resume against industry-standard scanning patterns. It checks your structure, headings, contact info, formatting, and highlights areas of improvement to make sure your document successfully passes Applicant Tracking Systems used by recruiters.

### Is Apply Tracker really free?

Yes, our core tools—including the job application tracker, interactive CV maker, and resume checker—are 100% free to use. There are no hidden fees or paywalls.

### Why should I track my job applications?

Organizing your job hunt prevents double-applying, keeps you prepared for follow-ups, and allows you to track key interview stages. It boosts your efficiency and provides stats on your application-to-interview success rate.

### Are my CVs and personal data secure?

Absolutely. We respect your privacy and employ secure data protection protocols. Your CVs, applications, and documents are safe and accessible only to you.
